name: fylgja
description: Fylgja in every Claude Code session: the knowledge-base tools in every project, pasted record references and links drawn as what they are, one-line receipts for writes, and a line when sign-in is needed. Scribe, a background reader on your own Claude plan, records decisions with their reasons in Fylgja, asks when one has none, and tells you what is recorded about the files in hand, in a band above the prompt. It never adds to what Claude reads and never delays a prompt.

scribe.title: Scribe
scribe.description: Scribe follows the session and records decisions with their reasons in Fylgja, asks when a decision has none, and tells you what is recorded about the files in hand. It uses your own Claude plan for its model calls. Off: nothing is read, asked or written.

scribeCadence.title: Scribe looks
scribeCadence.description: How often Scribe looks at the session while Claude works: after every 5 or 10 of Claude's steps, or only when a turn ends. It always looks when a turn ends, and right after you answer one of Claude's questions. Each look is one call on your Claude plan.

scribeModel.title: Scribe model
scribeModel.description: The model Scribe thinks with, on your own Claude plan. Sonnet is what Scribe was tuned on; Haiku costs less and misses more decisions that come without a reason; Opus costs more.

telemetry.title: Debugging events
telemetry.description: The plugin reports what it did to Fylgja, in counts and fixed words, so that a fault can be found: how a look of Scribe's ended, that a write was refused and by which rule, that the window did not open. Never code, file or repository names, paths, prompts, replies or the text of a record. Off: nothing is noted and nothing is sent.
